displayDescription: An idea's bulb contour stays locked while one labelled layer peels open and a red path traces five connected nodes.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, sound effects or narration.
limitations: The peel is a flat 2D fold: the layer is squeezed toward a hinge line and flipped to show its back. It is not a simulated 3D paper bend, so there is no perspective or lighting.
The circuit and node system is illustrative, not measured data.
STYLE.json lists no optional preview recipes, so the preview shows the main style's characteristic action.
No BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied. The background policy lets the scene decide, so a cool graph-paper background was chosen.

The step that records the final technology choice failed because PROJECT_DEPENDENCIES.json is missing. SVG (built into the browser) and the bundled gsap.min.js are the only tools used, and nothing was installed.
